- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

Have you ever been standing at a bus stop in France when the person next to you lets out a long "Pfff…" and starts grumbling about the late bus, and you weren't sure if they were really angry or if you were supposed to say something? Don't worry, they're probably not angry at all. In France, complaining together is almost a national sport, and there's a special word for it, râler.

In this video I'll show you the French expressions for frustration that people actually use every day, like "J'en ai marre !" or "Manquait plus que ça", with the right melody so they sound natural. And because you'll probably hear French people râler long before you do it yourself, I'll also give you the little phrases to react, so you can join in and be part of the conversation. À très vite !

#LearnFrench, #SpokenFrench, #FrenchCulture,
